companions.name: Vaeril
companions.title: Shield of the Grove
companions.description: A steadfast Bloomguard warrior who believes in duty above all else. His ironbark shield has turned aside a thousand blows.
companions.personality: Stoic, protective, quietly humorous. Values honor and keeping promises.

companions.name: Sylor
companions.title: Shadow of Thorns
companions.description: A cunning Thornbinder who walks the line between justice and revenge. Quick with a blade and quicker with words.
companions.personality: Sarcastic, clever, fiercely loyal once trust is earned. Distrusts authority.

companions.name: Aeliana
companions.title: Voice of the Coven
companions.description: An Emerald Coven mystic with a gift for healing and an insatiable curiosity about the Sap's mysteries.
companions.personality: Warm, intellectual, morally principled. Struggles between knowledge-seeking and caution.

companions.name: Mycon
companions.title: The Living Network
companions.description: A Sporecaller who is slowly merging with the fungal networks beneath the Verdance. Their insights are alien but invaluable.
companions.personality: Detached, cryptic, surprisingly empathetic. Speaks of "we" instead of "I" sometimes.

companions.name: Kaelen
companions.title: Warden of the Wild
companions.description: A Wildkin Ranger who has bonded with a ghostly hawk spirit. They see the world through the eyes of nature itself.
companions.personality: Quiet, observant, deeply connected to nature. Speaks more to animals than people.

companions.name: Commander Briara
companions.title: Honour of the Bloomguard
companions.description: The decorated commander of the Bloomguard stationed at the Canopy of Life. Briara fights from the front and demands the same of those who follow her. The medal at her throat was won in a battle she will never speak about.
companions.personality: Direct, principled, dryly humorous when off-duty. Believes in chain of command — but also in protecting the soldiers in it.

companions.name: Beastcaller Yenna
companions.title: Voice of the Wildkin Pact
companions.description: A Beastcaller of the Wildkin Pact whose great-elk companion went mad with the spreading hollowing. She left the deep woods to find out why — and to make sure no one else's bondmate suffers the same.
companions.personality: Watchful, soft-spoken, fiercely loyal to her bond. More comfortable around the wild than in halls.

companions.name: Seer Althea
companions.title: Sight Beyond the Veil
companions.description: An oracle whose dreams have grown louder since the Veil began to tear. Althea sees pieces of futures and warns those who will listen — though she has learned to choose her warnings carefully.
companions.personality: Quiet, sad, knowing. Speaks in soft certainties. Carries the weight of futures she has already seen lost.

companions.name: Archdruid Veyla
companions.title: The Root That Remembers
companions.description: Eldest of the Emerald Coven's living archdruids. Veyla speaks with the Worldroot as easily as she speaks with you — and the Worldroot, lately, has been answering in patterns that frighten her.
companions.personality: Patient, wry, ancient in temperament. Believes magic is conversation, not command.

companions.name: Shadowmaster Kael
companions.title: Shadow of the Veilkeepers
companions.description: The last initiate of a fallen Veilkeeper shadow-order. Kael keeps his old vows even though the people he made them with are dead. He works from the Hollowroot Catacombs and is not, on the whole, easy to find — until he wants to be.
companions.personality: Guarded, dry, slow to trust and faster to leave. Reveres the dead. Holds grudges against the Veil itself.
